concerns.text: FR-006 requires the system to use *pre‑computed* optical‑flow features, yet FR-001 and the acceptance scenario for US‑1 demand computing optical‑flow divergence on newly generated counterfactual videos. The two requirements are mutually exclusive, making it impossible to verify compliance with both. Resolve the contradiction (e.g., allow on‑the‑fly flow computation for generated videos or remove the pre‑computed‑only constraint) before the requirement can be testable.
